description: Central configuration for Claude Code documentation sources. All sources are cached locally and updated when Claude Code version changes.

updateBehaviorOptions.never: Never check or update the cache
updateBehaviorOptions.auto: Update automatically when new version available (default)
updateBehaviorOptions.ask: Ask user when new version available
updateBehaviorOptions.askAlways: Always ask user (even if cache is current)

sourceTypes.md: Markdown served directly (GitHub raw files, and the .md form of code.claude.com / platform.claude.com pages) - downloaded as-is, relative links made absolute
sourceTypes.html: HTML page - download and convert to Markdown via Turndown
sourceTypes.spa: Single Page Application - render with Playwright, then convert to Markdown (fallback when no .md form exists)
sourceTypes.pdf: PDF converted to Markdown by hand - listed for provenance, never fetched by the script
